content: मत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [मन्-क्त] .²1 Thought, believed, supposed; स मे युक्ततमो मतः <ls>Bg. 6. 47</ls>. .²2 Considered, regarded, deemed, looked upon. .²3 Esteemed, honoured, respected; बभौ च सा तेन सतां मतेन श्रद्धेव साक्षाद्विधिनोपपन्ना <ls>R. 2. 16</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 8</ls>. .²4 Commended, valued. .²5 Conjectured, guessed. .²6 Meditated upon, thought of, perceived, recognised. .²7 Thought out. .²8 Intended, aimed at. .²9 Approved, sanctioned. .²10 Wished or hoped for. .²11 Perceived, observed, known, understood. (See मन्). .{@-तम्@} .²1 A thought, idea, opinion, belief, view; निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् <ls>Bg. 18. 6</ls>; केषांचिन्मतेन <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Doctrine, tenet, creed, religious belief; ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः <ls>Bg. 3. 31</ls>. .²3 Advice, instruction, counsel. .²4 Aim, design, intention, purpose; आत्मप्रभावेण मुने ज्ञातुमर्हसि मे मतम् <ls>Rām. 7. 9. 19</ls>. .²5 Approbation, sanction, commendation. .²6 Knowledge.
